android.step1: Touch the Home screen, then open Widgets.

android.step3: Or use Add to Home screen below.

ios.step1: Touch and hold the Home Screen until the icons jiggle, then tap +.
ios.step2: Search for Taybah and choose a widget.
ios.step3: Tap Add Widget and place it where you want.

tour.readerMushaf: Mushaf view: the pages as in the printed Mushaf. Swipe to turn them.
tour.readerReading: Reading view: the ayahs flow in clear text you can enlarge, with tafsir under them if you choose one.
tour.readerFocus: Focus view: one ayah at a time, without distractions. Swipe for the next ayah.
tour.tafsir: Tap any ayah, then choose Tafsir to read its tafsir.
tour.myQuran: My Mushaf: your bookmarks, highlights and notes in one place.
tour.listenFollow: Press play next to any reciter, and the highlight follows the recitation ayah by ayah.
tour.salah: Prayer times for your city, with the qibla direction. Tap the location at the top to set or change your city.
tour.azkar: Choose the morning or evening azkar, then tap the counter with each dhikr.
tour.sibha: Tap anywhere on the screen to say tasbih, and the app counts for you.
tour.goals: Choose your daily reading goal, and the app follows your progress.
tour.search: Type a word from an ayah or a surah name to search.
tour.settings: Set the language, appearance and more here.
tour.widget: Add the Taybah widget to your Home Screen: the next prayer, continue reading and the misbaha.
